analysis.summary: Management reported a strong performance for H1 FY27, with total income rising 20.9% year-on-year to ₹168.66 Crores and EBITDA expanding by 51.9% to ₹88.56 Crores. The company's EBITDA margin improved by 1,071 basis points to 52.51%, driven by a larger owned fleet earning full day rates while operating costs remained flat. Furthermore, the company secured major new long-term charters, including a five-year charter for ARTEMIS with Hardy E&P and joint venture partners ONGC and Invenire. ABS Marine Services reported a strong financial performance in FY26, driven by owned fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and cost management, with consolidated total income rising 75.05% year-on-year to INR322.64 crores. During the year, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis and signed a five-year contract with Hardy Oil, while also planning further fleet additions and vessel dry docks.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company always tries to be very conservative and likes to perform better than what has been given.
guidance.quote: We always try to be very conservative and like to perform better than what we have given.

guidance.claim: Management expects a top-line increase of approximately 10% from current levels for the current financial year, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to continue in the band of 45% to 50%.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that ONGC has a 20-vessel tender that is expected to come out anytime soon.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that they took delivery of their multi-purpose support vessel and completed the Indian-flag registration of their new vessels.
capex_expansion.quote: We took delivery of our multi-purpose support vessel, completed the Indian-flag registration of our new vessels and secured long-term deployment for them.

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent a total of $15 million for both new vessels, Hades and the MPSV.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, EBITDA increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, with the EBITDA margin expanding by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: For H2 FY26, EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, and the EBITDA margin expanded by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated they fixed ARTEMIS on a firm five-year charter with Hardy Exploration & Production (India) Inc., acting for itself and its joint venture partners ONGC and Invenire Petrodyne.
orders_capacity.quote: We fixed ARTEMIS on a firm five-year charter with Hardy Exploration & Production (India) Inc., acting for itself and its joint venture partners ONGC and Invenire Petrodyne, which gives us strong revenue visibility.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals, with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter, two have recently come out of charter, and a third newly acquired vessel is headed for dry dock before market entry.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that currency exchange rate movement from INR82 per dollar to INR96 impacts the cost of vessel acquisition.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96. So, that is playing on the cost of the vessel.

management_commitments.claim: Management's priority for FY27 is to keep owned-fleet utilisation high, convert short-term deployments into long-term charters and keep bidding for tenders from oil majors and port authorities.
management_commitments.quote: Keep owned-fleet utilisation high, convert short-term deployments into long-term charters and keep bidding for tenders from oil majors and port authorities.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the vessel AM Passion is fixed at $19,000 per day for the next three years after the initial period.
management_commitments.quote: And then as of now, we are getting about $16,000 per day and that is fixed for three years. And then the next three years, it will be at $19,000.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
